summary: BW LPG Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 28, 2026. The meeting passed routine resolutions including re-election of directors (Andreas Sohmen-Pao, Anne Grethe Dalane, Sonali Asit Chandmal, Luc Bernard Marie Gillet, Sanjiv Misra), appointment of a new director (Kevin Mackay), re-appointment of chairman, approval of remuneration guidelines and director fees, and re-appointment of auditor KPMG LLP. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no special situation event. The Form 6-K is the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report. There are no deal terms, premium, or strategic changes to analyze.
